relationships.description: Protection detail, old cruelty, and a love that is chosen after rejection — not biology and not instant.
A six-year bond. Healthy, quarrelsome, and the model of love that already knows how to work.
Bonded soldiers. Loud and quiet, respectively. The bond is a strength Nia refuses to let become a tactical failure.
Alpha recon and beta biologist. They clash, then trust, then choose each other without a heat to blame.
Priya holds the school story before Calder remembers it. Friendship, not romance.
Commander and second. She translates his confidence into plans and will not let him confuse guilt with command.
Colleagues. His death was filed as rapids. She never believed the file.
Director and field commander. Same objective, different price. She will not follow him all the way to the Bell.
The Compact's protection detail against Helix Meridian's attempt to ring the Marrow Bell.
